title: CIA director makes rare, unannounced visit to Moscow
description: The trip came as Ukrainian forces have stepped up attacks deep inside Russia, including in the capital.

title: Judge issues setback to Trump administration plans to restrict mail-in ballots
description: The ruling is not the final word in a fast-moving legal fight over the administration’s efforts to change voting rules before the midterms.

title: House GOP faces complaint for using floor footage in campaign materials
description: The action targets Rep. Richard Hudson, chair of House Republicans’ campaign arm. Rules bar lawmakers from using recordings of official proceedings for campaigns.

title: What to know about the court fights over voting by mail
description: After the Supreme Court's ruling on Monday, where do things stand in the lawsuits over President Donald Trump's attempt to limit who can cast ballots by mail?

title: Court halts Ohio proof-of-citizenship requirement at motor vehicle offices
description: Ohio’s law requiring proof of citizenship at Bureau of Motor Vehicles’ offices conflicts with the federal National Voter Registration Act, the court said.

title: Trump is having trouble changing how Americans vote
description: Election experts say confusion, rather than actual changes to law, will be the main hindrance to voter participation in November.

title: Wisconsin prosecutor declines to charge Musk in election bribery investigation
description: The tech titan last year had offered voters a chance at a $1 million prize.

title: Sen. Darline Graham wins GOP nomination for U.S. Senate in South Carolina
description: In a major win for President Trump who went all in for the political newcomer, Sen. Darline Graham beat out longtime Congressman Ralph Norman in a special election primary runoff in South Carolina.

title: Trump says U.S. could rename Lake Ontario as Lake America amid Canada trade war
description: The president cited his tariff fight in a social media post, saying the United States doesn’t expect to be “doing much business with Ontario any longer.”

title: Secret Service says it is aware of Iranian state media video threatening Barron Trump
description: The footage, reportedly released by media linked to Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, claimed a $10 million bounty had been placed on the president’s youngest son.

title: DHS acknowledges the noncitizen numbers it touted on voter rolls were inflated
description: The Trump administration claimed to have found 250,000 noncitizens on the voter rolls in four states. But the agency's communications with states since then indicate that data was preliminary.

title: Canada hits back at the U.S. with tariffs as the countries' trade fight escalates
description: The measures come after President Trump imposed 50% tariffs on many Canadian goods and threatened more after trade talks broke down on Friday.

title: Several states will decide voter ID ballot measures this year
description: Voters in at least six states will soon decide ballot measures related to voter ID — the largest number of voter ID measures in a single year. The tally includes three prominent swing states.

title: As U.S.-Canada tensions escalate, Republicans could face political consequences
description: The threat of higher prices for gas, cars, hockey sticks and more gave fresh life to Democratic arguments that the president is destabilizing the economy.

title: Can Trump's economic war against Iran do what airstrikes and negotiations couldn't?
description: What a new round of U.S. sanctions could mean after nearly six months of war with Iran — and years of economic pressure on the country.

title: U.K. will help Ukraine make long-range missiles by sharing classified tech information
description: Burnham, who was in Kyiv for Ukraine's Independence Day, said defense firm MBDA will release details on U.K.-made parts for the SCALP missile to Ukraine to help the country assemble the weapons.

title: Trump administration plans to revoke up to 200,000 visas, official says
description: The 200,000 revocations will not happen in one fell swoop, but on a rolling basis, the Trump administration source said. But experts suggest that the revocation, while potentially precedent setting, is largely performative.

title: Log Cabin Republicans remove reference to trans people on website
description: The Republican gay rights group has decided to no longer focus on transgender issues.

title: Trump moves to reshape White House’s South Lawn
description: The president's latest construction project involves changing the lawn's slope to bring it flush with his new helipad.

title: What’s happening between the U.S. and Canada
description: And what it could mean for the American economy.

title: An aluminum smelter becomes part of Oklahoma Republican governor runoff election
description: A proposed $4 billion aluminum smelter pushed by President Trump is splitting Oklahoma Republicans.

title: Supreme Court gives Trump an interim win on his mail voting order, but hurdles loom
description: The Supreme Court paused a lower court's ruling that blocked key parts of Trump's order to limit voting by mail for the midterms. But U.S. Postal Service work on the order remains blocked nationwide.

title: A Census Bureau report on noncitizen voting has ties to a Trump-aligned think tank
description: A Trump-aligned think tank has ties to a highly unusual Census Bureau report that the president is using to renew false claims of widespread voting by non-U.S. citizens in 2020, NPR has learned.

title: See photos from the first IndyCar race in Washington
description: Drivers are dashing around the National Mall at speeds expected to exceed 185 mph.

title: This not-so-secret document is inspiring the left — and tripping up its candidates
description: The Democratic Socialists of America platform aims to upend the status quo. That can mean a bumpy ride for those trying to win in the short term.
